title: repository.publish_resolve joins the shared runtime command roster, with every contract digest mirror rotated
description:
ROW 1 of 4 for task-21be6e9055984413a651ce6ee331e2c8 ("An UNKNOWN publish effect has no operator exit"), filed by architect-73d103f8 on 2026-09-18 under the owner's direction to plan that row's four-row split now. This epic's first rail makes a new command kind a four-row job, following the exact precedent `preview.decide` set (task-c672815d roster+mirrors -> task-40e52fa8 refusal codes -> task-5f883e4e operator fence -> task-33ceae56 behaviour) and `release.decide` repeated. THIS row is the roster slice only: it adds the kind `repository.publish_resolve` to the shared runtime roster and rotates every contract digest mirror. It adds NO behaviour, NO refusal codes and NO daemon wiring (rows 2 and 3, then task-21be6e90 itself).

WHAT IT CHANGES. `RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS` in packages/contracts/src/runtime/runtime-vocabulary.ts:85. Regenerate the control-room client with its own generator (packages/control-room-client/generator/generate.ts:264 emits `export const GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST = ...`), never by hand-editing the generated file.

THE MIRROR COUNT IS NOT FOUR, AND MUST NOT BE FROZEN. The epic rail and the preview precedent say 'all four contract digest mirrors', but a full-tree grep of the CURRENT digest `cbe06719726c8bb40ff2e6273a91666adc63921d1138d1864f85becc5a2e5708` at HEAD 2026-09-18 returns FIVE files, and a DIFFERENT set from the precedent commit 0d1d6c46: packages/control-room-client/src/generated/generated-client.ts (the source), packages/control-room-client/src/generated-coverage.test.ts, apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/approve-plan.test.tsx, apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/approve-plan-reject.test.tsx and apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/plan-run-resolution.test.tsx. apps/control-room/src/data/data-adapter.test.ts WAS a mirror at 0d1d6c46 and is not one now. So the worker re-censuses at its OWN tree with `git grep -ln <current digest> -- . ':!dist' ':!.moe' ':!node_modules'` across ALL file types and updates every hit; the number is whatever that grep prints, and no DoD clause names it.

THE CONTROL-ROOM LEG IS MANDATORY. Three of the mirrors live under apps/control-room, which is in none of `pnpm test` (the root vitest include has no apps/**), `pnpm typecheck`, or the daemon leg: a forgotten mirror ships hard-throwing tests behind green gates. `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test` must run and be quoted.

apps/daemon/src/gates-roster-coherence.test.ts:190/:195 parses the digest out of the generated client by regex rather than holding a literal; it is not a mirror to edit, but it may classify every roster kind (human-only or not) and red on an unclassified new one. If it does, that classification belongs to row 3 (the operator fence) — report it rather than editing it here.

NEVER BUMP A LITERAL ANOTHER ROW IS BUMPING. Check the board for any other in-flight row that adds a runtime command kind or rotates this digest; two rows rotating one digest at once collide. Declare dependsOn on such a row rather than racing it.

Filed by me today as ROW 1 of the owner-directed split of task-21be6e90 (the operator exit). The roster slice only: no behaviour, refusal codes or daemon wiring. Measured at HEAD 2026-09-18.

(1) THE PRECEDENT'S EXACT RECIPE (commit 0d1d6c46, `preview.decide`). It inserted the kind into `RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS` in packages/contracts/src/runtime/runtime-vocabulary.ts at its SORTED slot, bumped runtime-contract.test.ts's hard-coded roster size by one, and ADDED a positional neighbour pin for the new kind — its comment explains why: "the generator sorts its copy and therefore cannot catch a misplaced source tuple". Then the client was regenerated and every digest mirror rotated.

(2) THE SLOT. runtime-vocabulary.ts:115-116 reads `..., "repository.bootstrap", "repository.publish", "repository.recover", "resource.confirm_released", ...`. So `repository.publish_resolve` goes between `repository.publish` and `repository.recover`: a string sorts after its own prefix, and `p` sorts before `r`.

(3) THE COUNT PIN IS LIVE AND HAS MOVED. runtime-contract.test.ts:113 `expect(commands.size).toBe(121)` — it was 103 at the precedent, which is exactly why this row's DoD names no number: take the leg's printed expected-vs-received. The existing positional pins at :158 and :168-170 bracket `product_contract.*`, `preview.*` and `policy.*`, all of which sort BEFORE `repository.*`, so inserting in the repository region moves none of them.

(4) THE GENERATOR. packages/control-room-client/package.json:18 `"generate": "node --experimental-strip-types generator/generate.ts"`. It emits `GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST` (generator/generate.ts:264) into packages/control-room-client/src/generated/generated-client.ts. REGENERATE; never hand-edit the generated file.

(5) FIVE DIGEST MIRRORS, not the four the epic rail and the precedent name. A full-tree grep of the current digest `cbe06719726c8bb40ff2e6273a91666adc63921d1138d1864f85becc5a2e5708` returns generated-client.ts (the source), packages/control-room-client/src/generated-coverage.test.ts, apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/approve-plan.test.tsx, apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/approve-plan-reject.test.tsx and apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/plan-run-resolution.test.tsx. apps/control-room/src/data/data-adapter.test.ts WAS a mirror at 0d1d6c46 and is not one now.

(6) A BUILT-IN CENSUS THAT BEATS ANY GREP. apps/daemon/src/gates-roster-coherence.test.ts has, at :188, `describe("every GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST mirror carries the current hex")`, which scans source trees for every mirror shape and asserts each holds the CURRENT hex, naming any stale one by file and line. So this row lands green on its own; classifying the kind as human-only is row 3's (gates-human-only-fence.test.ts), not this test's.

(7) NO COLLISION. A one-pass scan of every PLANNING / AWAITING_APPROVAL / WORKING / REVIEW / BLOCKED row for a roster or digest change found only this row, so no other row is rotating the digest concurrently.
